A cross-section of a rich tropical rainforest showing various forest products being utilized. On the left, a mature mahogany tree with a lumberjack in safety gear preparing to harvest timber. In the centre, a local woman gathering fallen branches for firewood and plucking wild fruits into a woven fibre basket. On the right, a rubber tree with a diagonal cut on its bark and a small cup collecting dripping white latex. Small animals (a monkey and a bird) are in the canopy.

An alley cropping farm layout. The illustration shows parallel rows of leafy shrubs (Leucaena) that have been heavily pruned at the top. In the wide alleys between these shrub rows, healthy green maize plants are growing. The ground around the maize is covered with cut leaves and branches (mulch) from the shrubs.
